basis: Reviewed production inclusions, independent of the dependency overview. A new component needs an inclusion witness here as well as the delivered-file gate. Development tools and design or porting references are not inclusions.

groups.witness: core/CMakeLists.txt links the engine; its installed SDK includes the mathematical libraries and platform OpenMP runtime. lib/CMakeLists.txt builds the nanobind extension, including robin-map.
app/CMakeLists.txt and cmake/EdiGuiBase.cmake link or embed the Qt modules and the shared QML components. The web kit embeds its C/C++ runtime; tools/ci/wasm-build.sh supplies its service worker.

data/elements/PROVENANCE.md identifies the original pymatgen element data in the compiled table. A porting project's name is not an original-data notice. Any further data-origin notice needs its own inclusion and licence witness.
data/report/vendor contains the actual report JavaScript files. Desktop resources and the delivered web site include these libraries.

data/colormaps/PROVENANCE.md records the original Crameri cmcrameri 78f02a08, Thyng cmocean 59c35002, Mikhailov Turbo dccf2856, Brewer colorbrewer_schemes 7d135fc4 and Kovesi CET 076eb84b sources. Their RGB tables are compiled from data/colormaps/*.tsv through cmake/edi_core_sources.cmake and core/src/colour_map_data.cpp.in; these original data inclusions require their notices independently of DEPENDENCIES.md.

The locked native Qt distribution supplies these linked libraries or platform plugins. The actual delivered-file gate remains necessary: this reviewed list is an inclusion ceiling, not proof that a particular package contains a library.
cmake/EdiGuiBase.cmake embeds the interface font resources; the report icon data also contains Font Awesome designs.
